# Zen Mesh — Webhook Operations

> Zen Mesh helps teams receive, validate, observe, and operate webhooks across Stripe, GitHub, custom sources, and planned launch targets Shopify and Twilio.

Version: 1.4.0 · Last-Updated: 2026-06-11T22:00:00Z · Product scope: webhook ingestion, validation, delivery visibility, and security operations (evidence-first federated operational runtime/trust platform).

Non-claims and proof scope are authoritative — see the Non-Claims and Wedge Evidence links below before inferring production readiness.

## Canonical discovery (crawlers)

- **Machine-readable host:** `https://docs.zen-mesh.io` — fetch `/llms.txt`, `/ai/ai-discovery-registry.json`, `/ai/security/v1/*`, and `/ai/evidence/v1/*` on this host only (direct `200`, `text/plain` or `application/json`; no client-side routing).
- **Marketing mirror:** `https://www.zen-mesh.io/llms.txt` — editorial index; `/ai/*` JSON is not hosted on www (use docs URLs below).
- **Apex:** `https://zen-mesh.io` — permanent redirect to www for site pages; use docs host for JSON registries.

- [Deduplication vs Idempotency](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/deduplication-vs-idempotency): System-level vs consumer-side duplicate handling

## Delivery capabilities

- [Dead Letter Queue](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/dead-letter-queue): Failed delivery preservation and recovery with configurable retention and retry policies
- [Webhook Replay](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/replay): Replay events from DLQ or delivery history for recovery and reprocessing
- [Webhook Deduplication](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/deduplication): Duplicate event detection and handling with configurable dedup keys
- [Webhook Filtering](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/filtering): Route or suppress events according to configured conditions
- [Webhook Fan-Out](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/fan-out): Deliver events to multiple destinations with per-destination policies
- [Webhook Idempotency](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/idempotency): Idempotency controls for safe retry and duplicate processing

## Security capabilities

- [IP Allowlisting](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/security/ip-allowlisting): Restrict delivery sources with identity-based allowlisting
- [Header Validation](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/security/header-validation): Verify event source authenticity with signature verification
- [Cryptographic Enrollment](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/security/cryptographic-enrollment): HMAC-based enrollment with X.509 SVID for component identity

## Delivery

- [JSONPath Routing](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/jsonpath-routing): Route webhooks with safe JSONPath filter and match rules — no code execution
- [JSONPath Transforms](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/delivery/jsonpath-transforms): Map and reshape webhook payloads with JSONPath expressions and safe transform functions

## V1 governance (2026-05-30)

- Not production-live, not customer-ready, not demo-ready as global platform readiness
- Canonical failure-stop: canonical script failure requires STOP — ad hoc runtime is not accepted evidence
- Integrity-chain authority: accepted deploy/UI/completion evidence artifacts require hash-chain inclusion; comparison is integrity-only — not authentication, not identity proof, not encryption, not replay prevention
- Planes management UI (T1): not product-pass; management-console boring-readiness not complete
- Runtime sandbox delivery validation: relay-path proof is mandatory for demo scope; see manifest proof_status for direct/egress/relay receipts — not a platform go-live claim
- Runtime workload identity (SVID) rotation: operational proof not complete on mainline
- DeliveryPolicy TLS/trust-chain controls: policy-driven delivery controls at L2 deferred — not PASS
- [Non-claims registry](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/ai/evidence/v1/non-claims.json)
